scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build:
mkdir -p public; (echo STAGE3_QUALITY_START; npm run quality; echo STAGE3_QUALITY_EXIT:$?; echo STAGE3_NEXT_BUILD_START; next build; echo STAGE3_NEXT_BUILD_EXIT:$?) > public/stage3-diagnostics.txt 2>&1; node scripts/capture-stage3-diagnostics.mjs; printf '

Stage 3 build diagnostics

' > public/index.html
